contest.measure_text: Shall the measure increasing the City of Hawthorne's transient occupancy (hotel) tax from 12% to 17%, to maintain City services such as police and fire protection, street repairs, park/recreation programs, and other general City services, generating approximately $3.1 million annually, paid only by hotel/lodging guests until ended by voters, with all funds staying local, be adopted? Supporters: Angie Reyes English, Hawthorne City Council Member; Alex Monteiro, Hawthorne City Council Member Opponents: None submitted.
contest.office: CITY OF HAWTHORNE SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION - MEASURE O
